# PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Contents of this Part

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Title | Number

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Solicitor acting for a party | Rule 42.1

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Change of solicitor – duty to give notice | Rule 42.2

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Order that a solicitor has ceased to act | Rule 42.3

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR] Removal of solicitor who has ceased to act on application of another party | Rule 42.4

## Solicitor acting for a party

## 42.1

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.1] (1) Where the address for service of a party is the business address of that party’s solicitor, the solicitor will be considered to be acting for that party until the provisions of this Part have been complied with.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.1] (2) For the purposes of this Part, ‘solicitor’ has the meaning set out in rule 6.2(d).

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.1] (Part 6 contains provisions about the address for service)

## Change of solicitor – duty to give notice

## 42.2

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (1) This rule applies where –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (a) a party for whom a solicitor is acting wants to change his solicitor;

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (b) a party, after having conducted the claim in person, appoints a solicitor to act on his behalf (except where the solicitor is appointed only to act as an advocate for a hearing); or

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (c) a party, after having conducted the claim by a solicitor, intends to act in person.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (2) Where this rule applies, the party or his solicitor (where one is acting) must –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (a) file notice of the change; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (b) serve notice of the change on every other party and, where paragraph (1)(a) or (c) applies, on the former solicitor.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (3) Except in the case of notice filed at court using MyHMCTS, the notice must state the party’s new address for service.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (4) The notice filed at court must state that notice has been served as required by paragraph (2)(b).

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (5) Subject to paragraph (6), where a party has changed his solicitor or intends to act in person, the former solicitor will be considered to be the party’s solicitor unless and until –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (a) notice is filed and served in accordance with paragraph (2); or

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (b) the court makes an order under rule 42.3 and the order is served as required by paragraph (3) of that rule.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (6) Where the determination that a person qualifies for civil legal services under Part 1 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 is –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (a) the solicitor who acted for that person will cease to be the solicitor acting in the case as soon as his retainer is determined –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (i) under regulation 4 of the Community Legal Service (Costs) Regulations 2000 1 ; or

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (ii) under regulation 83 of the Civil Legal Aid (General) Regulations 1989 2 ; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (b) if that person wishes to continue –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (i) where he appoints a solicitor to act on his behalf, paragraph (2) will apply as if he had previously conducted the claim in person; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (ii) where he wants to act in person, he must give an address for service.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.2] (Rules 6.23 and 6.24 contain provisions about a party’s address for service.)

## Order that a solicitor has ceased to act

## 42.3

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (1) A solicitor may apply for an order declaring that he has ceased to be the solicitor acting for a party.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (2) Where an application is made under this rule –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (a) notice of the application must be given to the party for whom the solicitor is acting, unless the court directs otherwise; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (b) the application must be supported by evidence.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (3) Where the court makes an order that a solicitor has ceased to act –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (a) a copy of the order must be served on every party to the proceedings; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.3] (b) if it is served by a party or the solicitor, the party or the solicitor (as the case may be) must file a certificate of service.

## Removal of solicitor who has ceased to act on application of another party

## 42.4

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (1) Where –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (a) a solicitor who has acted for a party –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (i) has died;

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (ii) has become bankrupt;

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (iii) has ceased to practice; or

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (iv) cannot be found; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (b) the party has not given notice of a change of solicitor or notice of intention to act in person as required by rule 42.2(2),

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] any other party may apply for an order declaring that the solicitor has ceased to be the solicitor acting for the other party in the case.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (2) Where an application is made under this rule, notice of the application must be given to the party to whose solicitor the application relates unless the court directs otherwise.

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (3) Where the court makes an order made under this rule –

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (a) a copy of the order must be served on every other party to the proceedings; and

[PART 42 – CHANGE OF SOLICITOR > 42.4] (b) where it is served by a party, that party must file a certificate of service.
